package.name: easyfleet_fake_alone_deployment
package.description: The "alone" deployment scenario: a single robot, robot_1, carrying all three fake/mock capabilities (reference implementations of the easyfleet_core NavigationActionServerBase / ManipulationActionServerBase / PerceptionActionServerBase classes) hosted together in one process (robot_node) -- kept separate from the example mission control program (alone_mission_node, built on easyfleet_mission_manager), which only ever talks to them over their ROS actions. Also ships the launch files and JSON/parameter configuration each is started with.
